description: Illustrative clause library. Every clause carries the statute it rests on and whether qualified legal sign-off is required before it is used.

clauses.clause_text_template: I {{client_full_name}} of {{client_address}} REVOKE all former wills and testamentary dispositions made by me and declare this to be my last Will.
clauses.source_statute: Wills Act 1837 s.20 (revocation by later will).

clauses.clause_text_template: I GIVE the residue of my estate to {{residuary_beneficiary}} absolutely.
clauses.source_statute: Wills Act 1837 s.9 (formal validity of the disposition).
clauses.notes: Residuary gifts carry the bulk of the estate; sign-off is mandatory before use.
